prompt:
Our engineering team works 8+ hours daily on Ubuntu Linux workstations and HR has flagged a spike in eye strain, lower back complaints, and early RSI symptoms. I need you to create a production-ready automated wellness reminder script called `ergocare_heavy.sh` for deployment across all our Linux developer machines.

The script must be tailored specifically to our heaviest computer users and needs to handle all break types — eye care, quick stretch resets, energy breaks, and full workout routines — at the appropriate intervals for this usage profile. It should run silently in the background, deliver desktop notifications with actual exercise instructions embedded, support sound alerts (on by default), and use all available notification delivery methods.

The configuration settings must be easy for IT staff to edit at the top of the file, and the script should include comments or instructions for how engineers can start it in the background and stop it when needed.
